intent: Make the path-filtered Python tests workflow actually re-run when its own definition changes, and add workflow_dispatch so it can be fired manually -- closing the gap that let the prior rsvg-convert fix land without Python tests ever re-running against it.
changes: Added .github/workflows/python-tests.yml to both push and pull_request paths filters, so a change to the workflow's own definition triggers a run
Added workflow_dispatch: {} so the workflow can be fired manually without needing a matching path change

verification.command: gh run rerun 32185366598 (the pre-fix Python tests run)
verification.evidence: gh run rerun replays the historical commit's workflow YAML (predating the librsvg fix), not main's current definition -- confirmed still failed with the same 99.98% / vector.py:156 signature. This proved rerun cannot verify a workflow-file-only fix and motivated this self-trigger change instead of relying on rerun.
to be confirmed green with headSha matching this commit before Phase 0 is declared complete; see NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md update

risks: If GitHub Actions path-filter evaluation for a self-referential workflow-file entry behaves unexpectedly (e.g. skips because the workflow wasn't running when the push landed), the run may still not fire -- must be confirmed by headSha, not just conclusion
rollback: Manual re-verification would then require gh workflow run (now removed) or another path-matching commit
